🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Neutrality is supported by weak sector breadth and mixed sector returns; risk and cycle signals are unavailable, so there is no basis for a stronger regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads (+3.36% 1W, +8.10% 1M): CHTR (1W: +13.36% | 1M: +27.45%) ABOVE TREND and TTWO (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +15.47%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities (+1.22% 1W) follow, with CEG (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.12%) RECOVERY; Energy is up 0.40% for the week but down 6.51% for the month.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary leads the weekly laggards (-1.71%): TJX (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -3.57%) BELOW TREND and BKNG (1W: -6.29% | 1M: +1.71%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples (-1.27%) and Healthcare (-1.24%) also weakened; PM (1W: -7.07% | 1M: -1.48%) is BELOW TREND, while ISRG (1W: -6.76% | 1M: +6.51%) is in CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +13.36% | 1M: +27.45%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: -8.69%) RECOVERY; CVS (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +2.98%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.12%) RECOVERY; VST (1W: +10.94% | 1M: -17.81%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); no clear style leadership confirmed by sector breadth.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -5.56% | 1M: -25.86%) BELOW TREND; SRE (1W: -5.65% | 1M: -5.04%) BELOW TREND; TJX (1W: -5.75% | 1M: -3.57%) BELOW TREND; SYK (1W: -6.14% | 1M: +12.83%) CORRECTION; MSFT (1W: -6.24% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND. Weakness spans Technology, Utilities, Consumer Discretionary and Healthcare.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves include CHTR (1W: +13.36% | 1M: +27.45%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: -8.69%) RECOVERY and CVS (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +2.98%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence is present across several large stocks, including GOOGL (1W: +1.56% | 1M: -17.05%) RECOVERY and JPM (1W: -2.48% | 1M: +3.61%) CORRECTION; watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is mixed on the week (-0.04%) but weak over the month (-8.88%); constituent breadth counts were not provided. AMD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: -8.69%) is in RECOVERY, while MSFT (1W: -6.24% | 1M: -4.11%) and NVDA (1W: -13.19% | 1M: -23.98%) are BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are down 0.97% for the week but up 4.79% for the month; constituent breadth counts were not provided. JPM (1W: -2.48% | 1M: +3.61%), V (1W: -2.34% | 1M: +7.64%) and MA (1W: -1.78% | 1M: +9.25%) are all in CORRECTION.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare fell 1.24% this week despite a 9.66% monthly gain; constituent breadth counts were not provided. JNJ (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +12.79%) and LLY (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +23.21%) are ABOVE TREND, while ISRG (1W: -6.76% | 1M: +6.51%) is in CORRECTION.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Keep positioning selective: favor relative strength in communication and monitor healthcare leaders, while reducing exposure to persistent technology weakness. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; the 4/11 positive-sector breadth does not confirm a Growth or Value tilt.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: CHTR (1W: +13.36% | 1M: +27.45%) ABOVE TREND, if communication-sector momentum persists; CVS (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +2.98%) ABOVE TREND, if recent strength holds. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -13.19% | 1M: -23.98%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -6.24% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND, if selling pressure continues.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication, up 3.36% for the week and 8.10% for the month; Utilities, up 1.22% for the week. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (-1.71% 1W) and Technology (-0.04% 1W, -8.88% 1M); overall breadth remains limited at 4/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not provided; monitor trend confirmation instead. NVDA (1W: -13.19% | 1M: -23.98%) BELOW TREND needs stabilization, while AMD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: -8.69%) RECOVERY needs follow-through; CHTR (1W: +13.36% | 1M: +27.45%) ABOVE TREND is a momentum-continuation watch.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (+80): buyback announcement; LRCX (1W: +6.53% | 1M: -21.66%) RECOVERY, a weekly rebound against a weak monthly trend. LLY (+75): China approval catalyst; LLY (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +23.21%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed by price. AMD (+45): cited as a potential beneficiary amid scrutiny of a rival; AMD (1W: +13.12% | 1M: -8.69%) RECOVERY, short-term price strength but monthly divergence.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (-75): reports of board turmoil; NVDA (1W: -13.19% | 1M: -23.98%) BELOW TREND, negative sentiment confirmed. INTC (-35): competitive concerns; INTC (1W: +7.26% | 1M: -39.21%) RECOVERY, short-term rebound diverges from the sharp monthly decline. CVS (-40): price-target reduction; CVS (1W: +11.96% | 1M: +2.98%) ABOVE TREND, price action diverges from the negative headline.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime; style mixed / no clear leadership. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).
CHTR (1W: +13.36% | 1M: +27.45%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +23.21%) ABOVE TREND show relative strength.
Major trend divergence and negative sentiment around NVDA (1W: -13.19% | 1M: -23.98%) BELOW TREND remain key risks; watch for confirmation before making a stronger regime call.
